presets.name: Voice clarity
presets.note: A low cut at 80 Hz, less mud at 250 Hz, a little presence and air: a common first move on a spoken voice.

presets.name: Rumble cut
presets.note: A high-pass at 80 Hz takes out traffic, handling noise and air conditioning.

presets.name: De-mud
presets.note: A low cut at 60 Hz and a broad 4 dB dip around 300 Hz clear a boxy sound.

presets.name: Presence lift
presets.note: 3 dB around 4 kHz helps a voice cut through.

presets.name: Air lift
presets.note: A gentle high shelf from 12 kHz.

presets.name: Telephone
presets.note: Cuts below 300 Hz and above 3.4 kHz with a lift at 1.5 kHz.

presets.name: Acoustic guitar
presets.note: Less boom at 200 Hz, a touch of string detail at 5 kHz and above.
